title: Nutty Flaky Slovakian Baby Pak Koi Lasagna
description: A comforting Slovakian dish featuring nutty flaky layers and tender baby pak koi, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This low-calorie-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Cook the whole wheat lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
Sauté the baby pak koi in a little bit of oil until tender.
In a blender, combine 1/4 cup of nutritional yeast, 1/4 cup of olive oil, and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice to make a cheesy sauce.
In a separate pan, sauté the mixture from the blender until it thickens.
Layer the cooked noodles, pak koi mixture, and cheesy sauce in a baking dish.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of cheesy sauce on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
